elements.name: Reopen a saved conversation after reload and continue from its earlier fact

steps.name: a disposable custom agent is selected in a fresh browser conversation
I give the agent a fresh fact in the browser
I reload the page and reopen that conversation from the thread list
the reopened conversation shows the saved turns without a new run
